evidence.title: Search. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: Search.
summary: Article comparing AI search tools and arguing Grok 4.20 is now the best, with a search benchmark and copy-paste prompts.
description: A How to AI issue on which AI tool is best for finding information: what changed since the last seven-tool test, why Grok 4.20 replaced Perplexity, how to customize your own search agents, the 63-query search benchmark, and a set of best-of search prompts.
